newsitem.title: FINLAND: Calmer Helsinki ticks ahead with Nokia, Raisio.
newsitem.headline: Calmer Helsinki ticks ahead with Nokia, Raisio.

text.p: Shares rose on Thursday in a quieter session than earlier this week with most of the action back in benchmark Nokia and plenty of attention on Raisio, which briefed investors about its international plans for Benecol.
The HEX index ended up 0.69 percent at 2,247.80 with volume at 300 million markka, about one-fifth each in Nokia and Raisio.

But the outlook was not entirely sunny, with the market vulnerable to potential international profit-taking and some brokers voicing nerves as the December FOX index future traded at 786.00, up 4.00 but at a discount to the FOX index at 791.59.
"The derivatives market expects the bourse to turn lower," one broker said; although futures activity in Finnish equities can be very thin and an unreliable indicator.

Positives included Nokia, which added five markka to 214.00 amid solid demand. Brokers said it may have been helped by a briefing to analysts on network access systems, but no one at Nokia was available to elaborate.

Raisio also saw plenty of action, initially falling but turning around sharply to end up 4.10 markka at 306.50 as it briefed investors about the international launch of its cholesterol-reducing margarine. Signs of a solution to raw material supply problems helped, brokers said.
